params.script_inline:
import sys, json
json.load(sys.stdin)
# Silent terminal: inbound user messages to a push-only bot carry nothing to
# persist (cookbook: swallow what you expect). Emits NOTHING, ever.
sys.stdout.write(json.dumps([]))

description.purpose: Silent terminal for the notifier's inbound lane (emit_to): a push-only digest bot has nothing to persist from inbound chats.
description.use_when: emit_to target of a delivery-only proxy. S1 addendum 2026-06-11: /colony/dead_letters as an EMISSION target is the READ endpoint (the listing reply travels back and dies at the consumes check) - never use it as a discard.
description.not_in_scope: No persistence - use the in-tree drain/errors pattern where errors should be visible.
examples: inbound Telegram chat to the digest bot -> swallowed silently
